content.title: Planning a trip to Costco this Easter? Read This First
content.text: Is Costco Open or Closed on Easter? What to Know for 2026If shopping at Costco is on your Easter to-do list, read this first.April 4, 2026, 2:00 PM CDTIf your Easter plans include a trip to Costco, here's what to know on the wholesaler's holiday hours for 2026. Kevin Carter / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleIt's Easter. Whether you're coloring eggs, assembling Easter baskets or curating an Easter songs' playlist for friends and family, you may find yourself in need of a few last-minute essentials to ensure that this year's celebration is a success.Given that Easter Sunday is one of the biggest commemorations on the Christian calendar, many stores, businesses and restaurants are closed in observance of the April holiday. If you're wondering if Costco will be open on Easter this year, see below for all the details you need to know about store hours and whether or not the wholesale giant will be welcoming customers on Sunday, April 5.It's important to note that Costco typically closes on many major holidays throughout the year, including Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's Day and Independence Day. But what about Easter?Read on for the most up-to-date information on Costco's hours, how to find a Costco store near you, as well as a list of other retailers that will be open and closed on Easter Sunday. As always, it's a good idea to confirm Easter hours ahead of visiting any store since openings, closings and hours can vary among retailers.Is Costco Open on Easter 2026?On Sunday, April 5, Costco warehouses will be closed in observance of Easter. Stores will reopen on Monday, April 6, during normal business hours, which may vary by location. To confirm local Costco hours and other details, find a store locator right here. Stores Open on Easter 2026Though Costco will be closed this Easter, see below for a sampling of retailers and grocers that will remain open on Sunday or find a complete list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going. Find local hours here.Dollar General: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Home Depot: Stores will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Hours may vary by location.
